altitude.description: Breather rate by height, piecewise linear, increasing y (1 if omitted).

breathers.description: Ease to a stop, catch breath (head down, a look back at a teammate, or a slight crouch), carry on. Effort-based: more often on climbs and higher up, rare low down. Omit for no breathers.

paceAltitude.description: Pace multiplier by height, piecewise linear, increasing y (a slower trudge higher up).

jacketRgb.description: Jacket dye colour (the hood takes it too); -1 for the undyed gold suit with its black hood.

pantsRgb.description: Pants dye colour; -1 undyed. Boots are never dyed.

packRgb.description: Traveler's Backpack dye colour; -1 for no pack.

quietSec.description: Distant Horizons must have no work in flight (executors, retrieval and network request queues, render uploads, sections building) for this long.

stallSec.description: Sections still missing data or drawn coarser than wanted count as done once their number has not changed for this long while DH is idle (nothing more to get, e.g. past the map edge).

minSec.description: Shortest settle at the start pose.

timeoutSec.description: Give up after this long in total (warm pass included).

onTimeout.description: fail: the render fails with TIMEOUT and the gate report in error.data; continue: film anyway with a warning. Previews always continue.

warm.description: Visit points along the camera path first (the spectator rides along).

warmQuietSec.description: How long DH must be idle before moving to the next warm point.

frameStability.description: Cross-check: the picture must hold still.

frameThreshold.description: Mean block-brightness change (0..255) that counts as still.

stills.description: Write <shot>_gate_start.png and <shot>_gate_done.png next to the video, to check by eye that done means detailed.

nearRadius.description: Missing or queued LOD positions within this many blocks of the camera count as still to come (farther ones never block: DH requests out to its whole radius).

waitForSync.description: Also wait for the server sync-on-load queue (re-checks every cached LOD on arrival).

frameMaxWaitSec.description: Once DH is ready, how long the picture gets to hold still (moving clouds and weather may never let it).

visible.description: Render the player model (default: not riding).

ride.description: Move the spectator player along with the camera so chunks load around it.

yaw.description: Minecraft yaw in degrees: 0 faces south (+Z), 90 west, 180 north, -90 east.

shaders.description: Switch shaders on/off for this shot (omit to leave as is).

actors.description: Spawned before warm-up; timelines start on the first frame; despawned after the take.

keepActors.description: Leave the actors in the world after the take.

block.description: Particle class-name prefixes not drawn during the shot (runtime names: intermediary for vanilla, e.g. net.minecraft.class_5685 = snowflake).

clear.description: Clear live particles as the take starts.

particles.description: Keep particles out of a take (e.g. stray weather snow in a calm vista); world.particles lists what is live by class.

serverTickSync.description: Slow the server to the render speed so mobs and weather keep pace.

offscreen.description: auto: resize the window, and render offscreen at the requested size if the screen cannot hold it (e.g. 3840x2160 on a smaller screen); the window shows the frame scaled. always: offscreen. never: record at the window size.
